jobs.description: Pro Industry  - Zaandam - €2.300,- tot €3.000,- p.m. - Energie en afval - 2 ploegendienst Do you want to stay physically active and contribute to a better world? As a sorter in Zaandam, you will recover valuable metals from waste streams. You will earn a great salary of up to €3,000 gross per month working in a 2-shift system. Are you looking for a meaningful job working outdoors? Apply for this vacancy today and get started quickly with this great employer! About this company This company is a global specialist in processing residual products from power plants. They extract metals and minerals from bottom ash for reuse in the construction industry, making an important contribution to a circular economy. The company culture is down-to-earth, open, and results-driven, with safety always being everyone's number one priority. The work environment is industrial and high-tech, featuring modern installations. Within the close-knit teams, there is a hands-on mentality with short lines of communication. Employees are given plenty of room for training and personal growth. Here, you will make a tangible social impact every day in an environment where everyone knows and helps each other. Functieomschrijving As a sorter, you ensure that metals are properly extracted from bottom ash. You stay active and on the move all day long. You work along the conveyor belt, picking out metals such as copper or stainless steel, and placing them into the correct bins. This requires speed and a keen eye for different types of materials. By doing so, you help create a pure end product. As a sorter, you play a major role in the recycling process. You spend your day actively sorting raw materials, making your work essential for a better environment. Functievereisten We believe that a good fit is more important than a perfect CV. Do you recognize yourself in this? Then we would love to hear from you! - You speak Dutch or English well enough to do your job. - ...

CNC Operator Conventional turning outdated? Not in our work!Alongside CNC machining, conventional techniques continue to offer plenty of challenges.You will perform turning operations on components up to Ø1,500 x 8,000 mm, weights up to 8,000 kg. Most parts are one-offs, requiring precise work, patience, and perseverance. First time right is more important than speed.In addition to conventional turning, knowledge of 3-axis CNC milling is preferred. If you don’t have this yet, no problem! You are eager to learn and willing to develop these skills.We understand that it can take 1 to 2 years for a new colleague to reach the desired level in our field. We start with a one-year contract, but aim to convert it to a permanent position as soon as possible.We work daytime shifts, and a 4-day workweek is available if you prefer.Requirements •    At least a level 3 vocational education (MBO 3) or equivalent; a completed qualification is a plus but not required.•    Hands-on experience in machining.•    Practical, solution-oriented, and eager to learn.Personal qualities•    Patient and persistent, with a strong work ethic•    Thinks before starting a task•    Works in a structured and precise manner, with a clear understanding of the job at hand•    Able to work independently, but also thrives in a team environment•    Speaks English Examples of jobs- Compressor rotor- Double-acting hydraulic cylinder- Screw compressor housing- Turbine shaft- Drive roller- Propeller shaftPlease send your resume/cv and  motivation to annelies.jansen-01@uwv.nl

This internship is primarily intended as a learning experience and is designed to provide practical experience in data management, digitalisation, process improvement, and organisational IT systems within a small international organisation.At the beginning of the internship, you and your internship supervisor will establish a structured internship plan with clear learning objectives, expected outcomes, and personal development goals. Throughout the internship, you will receive regular supervision, coaching, and feedback. Progress and learning objectives will be reviewed periodically to support your professional development.The internship focuses on understanding how data, digital tools, and workflows are used within EFFoST and on developing practical solutions to improve organisational effectiveness.Internship structureDuring the first phase of the internship, you will familiarise yourself with the organisation, its systems, and its data processes. As part of your learning trajectory, you will analyse current practices and identify opportunities for improvement, including:- Mapping current data flows and information processes- Understanding how different files, databases, and data sources are used- Identifying inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement- Evaluating the current use of digital tools- Developing proposals for improved workflows and practical automationBased on these analyses, you will develop a digitalisation project proposal as part of your internship objectives. Together with your supervisor, you will determine which activities can be implemented during the internship period and how these support your learning goals.During the second phase of the internship, you will gain practical experience by contributing to selected digitalisation initiatives, data-related projects, and workflow improvements.
